units.source_text: 今年隐忍过去，终于不曾出家。

en.t: This year he endured and let it pass, and in the end he did not take holy orders.

units.source_text: 但遁世之期，渐渐迫近，心绪忙乱，感慨无穷。

en.t: But the time for him to withdraw from the world was drawing steadily nearer, leaving his heart troubled and his feelings beyond measure.

units.source_text: 他考虑出家前应有种种措施，取出各种物品，

en.t: He thought over the various arrangements he should make before becoming a monk and brought out all sorts of belongings,

units.source_text: 按照等级分赠各侍女，作为纪念。

en.t: then distributed them among the gentlewomen according to rank as keepsakes.

units.source_text: 并不公然表明今将离世，但近身的几个侍女，

en.t: He did not openly say that he was now about to leave the world, but the few women who served closest to him

units.source_text: 都看得出他即将成遂夙愿了。

en.t: could all tell that he was about to fulfill his long-cherished wish.

units.source_text: 故岁暮之时，院内异常岑寂，悲伤之情无限。

en.t: Thus, as the year drew to its close, the residence became unusually silent, and the sorrow there seemed boundless.

units.source_text: 源氏在整理物件之时，偶尔发见昔年恋人寄来的许多情书。

en.t: While Genji was putting his things in order, he happened to discover many love letters sent by women he had loved in former years.

units.source_text: 如果留传于后世，教人看见，有所不便，

en.t: If they were handed down to later generations and seen by others, it would be awkward,

units.source_text: 而毁弃又觉可惜，所以当时保存了少许。

en.t: yet it had seemed a pity to destroy them, so at the time he had kept a few.

units.source_text: 此时便取出来，命侍女们毁弃。

en.t: Now he took them out and ordered the gentlewomen to destroy them.

units.source_text: 忽见须磨流放时各处寄来的情书中，有紫夫人的信件，另行结成一束。

en.t: Suddenly he noticed that among the letters sent from various places during his exile at Suma, Lady Murasaki's letters had been tied separately into one bundle.

units.source_text: 这是他自己亲手整理的，然而已经是遥远的往事了。

en.t: He had arranged them with his own hands, yet that was already a thing of the distant past.

units.source_text: 但现在看来笔墨犹新。

en.t: But even now, the brushwork and ink still looked fresh.

units.source_text: 这真可作为“千年遗念”，不过想到自己出家之后，

en.t: These could truly have served as a keepsake for a thousand years, but when he thought that after he became a monk

units.source_text: 无缘再看，则保存也是枉然，便命两三个亲信的侍女，

en.t: he would have no chance to look at them again, keeping them seemed pointless, so he ordered two or three trusted gentlewomen

units.source_text: 就在自己面前当场毁弃。

en.t: to destroy them then and there before his own eyes.

units.source_text: 即使不是情深意密的信，凡是死者的手迹，看了总多感慨。

en.t: Even when a letter was not filled with deep and intimate feeling, the handwriting of the dead always stirred many emotions when seen.

units.source_text: 何况紫夫人的遗墨，源氏一看便觉两眼昏花，

en.t: How much more so with Lady Murasaki's remaining words; the moment Genji looked at them, his eyes grew dim,

units.source_text: 字迹也难以辨别，眼泪滴满了信纸。

en.t: until even the writing was hard to make out, and his tears fell all over the paper.

units.source_text: 深恐众侍女看了笑他心肠太软，自觉不好意思，

en.t: He was deeply afraid that the gentlewomen would see him and laugh at him for being too tenderhearted, and he felt ashamed of himself,

units.source_text: 并且难于为情，便把信推向一旁，吟诗云：

en.t: and, overcome with embarrassment, he pushed the letters aside and recited this poem:
